The contract and its documentation: api/openapi.yaml served at /api/openapi.yaml, and a page that documents it at /docs (Scalar), outside production unless &lt;APP>_DOCS=true.

```esquadro
blueprint api_docs
```

## Works with

- **Requires** [rest](../rest/): the app must use them too.

## Environment variables

Read when the app starts; see [Environment variables](/esquadro/language/environment/).

| Variable | Type | Value | |
|---|---|---|---|
| `<APP>_DOCS` | bool | `true`; production: `false` | Serve the documentation page at /docs. |
